- **Strategy**: `docs/strategy/2026-06-27-dentino-layer-strategy.md` — §3.2, §5.1b (I2 owner = L2), §4.3 (tier-6 split — L2 owns totality/steal/heartbeat-not-pinged), §6 step 5 (ordering only)
- **Research (cite)**: §2.3 #7/#8, §5.6, §5.7b, §6.3.3, §6.4, ADR-003, ADR-013, ADR-018, ADR-020.

## Coordination Protocol (MANDATORY)
```bash
bin/br-claim <bead-id>
bin/br-complete <bead-id>   # only after committed+pushed+tests pass
```

Wrapper invocation must produce Agent-Mail `[<bead-id>] Start` and `[<bead-id>] Complete` audit messages through `bin/br-claim` / `bin/br-complete`; raw `br update --status` or `br close` is not an acceptable substitute.

## Context
Makes "every non-terminal status has an automated exit" hold even with zero future Edge firings (the `pg_cron` backstop), reconciles multi-firing against the pinned denominator, and proves the run happened via the external dead-man's-switch (success only on green/amber).

## Spec Requirements (verbatim)

### NFR-L2-DATA-04 — I2 Total State Machine (spec §5)
- AC-NFR-L2-DATA-04-a: `sending` rows have all three research §5.7b exits: next-firing reaper, on-steal sweep, and scheduled `maintenance.reap_stale_sends()` backstop to `send_unknown` or the research-defined terminal outcome.
- AC-NFR-L2-DATA-04-b: Patient actions whose ClinicCards write-back did not complete are retried by fenced run-owned paths before reconciliation and by scheduled maintenance sweep using `crm_writeback_ok is not true` as the predicate.
- AC-NFR-L2-DATA-04-c: A killed sole firing with no later Edge invocation is still recovered by the `pg_cron` backstop within one configured sweep interval.
- AC-NFR-L2-DATA-04-d: Staff-owned exception states such as unresolved `send_unknown` after automated resolution paths or breaker-held cancels are deliberate, surfaced, and not silent human-only limbo.
- AC-NFR-L2-DATA-04-e: The totality invariant is not considered v1-complete until the scheduled backstop exists and is tested; L2 is ordered later than L1 but is not optional for v1.

### FR-L2-RUN-07 — Multi-Firing Reconciliation and Proof-of-Run (spec §6)
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-a: Reconciliation uses the lease-holder's latest successful target-date fetch and typed `crm_visit_facts` denominator, with the catch-up pass's own pre-send fetch authoritative for that pass.
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-b: The external heartbeat receives start/fail/success pings with counts-only payloads and no PII.
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-c: The success ping is sent only after green or amber reconciliation, never merely because the Edge invocation returned HTTP success.
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-d: If the noon run has not completed by 12:30 Kyiv, the external monitor alerts the same day.
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-e: `GET /healthz` exists as liveness/readiness and is distinct from the noon dead-man's-switch.
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-f: Green requires a successful CRM fetch and zero unaccounted, pending, sending, unresolved `send_unknown`, failed, and known-skip counts for current remindable appointments; amber allows accounted known staff-work skips; red covers CRM-fetch failure, unaccounted work, pending/sending after the final firing, unresolved `send_unknown`, or failed sends/writes.
- AC-FR-L2-RUN-07-g: A failed success-ping delivery is an operations alert but does not mutate `reminder_days.health`; DB reconciliation health and monitor receipt remain distinct signals.

### NFR-L2-RUN-08 — Runtime Budgets and Queue Migration Triggers (spec §6)
- AC-NFR-L2-RUN-08-a: Normal sendable volume is supported up to 50 reminders per run.
- AC-NFR-L2-RUN-08-b: Seven-day p95 run duration target is <=120 seconds, and SMS submit p95 target is <=3 seconds.
- AC-NFR-L2-RUN-08-c: Edge `WallClockTime` shutdowns target zero.
- AC-NFR-L2-RUN-08-d: The engine stops claiming new sends near the researched deadline window before the hard Edge wall-clock cap and reconciles/fails safely.
- AC-NFR-L2-RUN-08-e: Queue/worker migration is triggered, rather than silently stretching the single-invocation model, if any research §6.4 threshold is breached: `sendable_total > 100`, seven-day p95 run duration >180 seconds, any Edge `WallClockTime` shutdown, or any run leaves pending work past the 12:30 heartbeat deadline.

## Tests To Pass (verbatim from TDD)

### IT-TOTALITY-01 — Tier 6 / Rung C / Owner L2
> Kill the only firing mid-send with no later Edge firing; `maintenance.reap_stale_sends()` transitions `sending` to `send_unknown` within one sweep, never resends blindly, and no non-terminal state lacks an automated exit.

### IT-HEARTBEAT-01 — Tier 6 / Rung C / Owner L2
> Start/fail/success pings are counts-only and PII-free; red/shortfall reconciliation never pings success; success ping happens only after green/amber reconciliation; failed success-ping delivery alerts without mutating DB health.

### IT-WRITEBACK-REAPER-02 — Tier 6 / Rung C / Owner L2
> With no later Edge firing, scheduled maintenance re-drives an action committed before CRM write until landed or explicit error; the row is not a human-only-exit crash gap.

### IT-RECON-01 (multi-firing portion) — Tier 6 / Rung C
> Induced single-firing shortfall (`pending`, deleted materialized row, stale fingerprint, vanished unresolved) makes health red and unaccounted/pending count nonzero. (L2 extends to the multi-firing pinned-denominator + heartbeat-not-pinged-on-red assertion.)

### IT-BUDGET-01 — Tier 6 / Rung C / Owner L2
> Run stops claiming near the deadline window, leaves `pending`/partial/red safely, tracks p95 budgets, and triggers queue migration conditions instead of stretching single invocation.

### PGTAP-MAINT-01 (reap portion) — Tier 2 / Rung B / Owner L2/L4
> `maintenance.reap_stale_sends()` and `maintenance.purge_privacy()` run under dedicated maintenance roles, touch only permitted objects, and write counts-only audit rows.

## Files to Create/Modify
- `supabase/functions/run-reminders/index.ts` (multi-firing reconciliation + start/fail/success pings + budget/deadline guard).
- `maintenance.reap_stale_sends()` **scheduled** via `pg_cron`; the `pg_cron` CRM-write reaper sweep.
- `GET /healthz`; external monitor start/fail/success ping URLs (`HEALTHCHECKS_*`).
- `tests/pgtap/maintenance.sql`, totality/heartbeat integration tests.

## Acceptance Criteria (this bead is done when)
1. AC-NFR-L2-DATA-04-a..e, FR-L2-RUN-07-a..g, NFR-L2-RUN-08-a..e hold; the listed tier-6 + tier-2 tests green.
2. The reconciliation-shortfall red-state is asserted AND the success heartbeat URL is NOT pinged (the fail URL is).
3. A killed sole firing with no later firing is recovered by the `pg_cron` backstop within one sweep.

## Gotchas & Anti-Patterns
- Success ping ONLY after green/amber reconciliation — never because the Edge invocation returned HTTP 200.
- A failed success-ping is an ops alert, NOT a DB-health mutation (two distinct signals).

- **Blocked by:** L2-1 (scheduler/catch-up).
- **Blocks:** L3 trust/value panels; L4.
- **Layer:** L2. **Labels:** `l2`, `reliability`.

## Spec Requirements (verbatim)

### NFR-L4-SEC-03 — Security Go-Live Gate (spec §8)
> Before production go-live, the security gate shall pass as a release gate.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-a: Tokens are 128-bit capabilities stored only as HMAC digests.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-b: `GET` and `HEAD` on `/r/{token}` produce zero business writes.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-c: Nonce-less POST fails.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-d: Cancel requires the interstitial/destructive confirmation path.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-e: Double POST yields exactly one recorded business action.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-f: Expired, superseded, stale-CRM, and terminal-status tokens cannot act.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-g: Mass-cancel circuit breaker hard-open halts writes, not merely alerts.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-h: Full phone numbers are absent at rest.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-i: Token URLs and raw tokens are redacted from logs and monitoring.
- AC-NFR-L4-SEC-03-j: Non-allowlisted sends/writes are refused with zero provider calls and zero CRM writes; empty allowlist refuses all; only `full` lifts allowlists.

### NFR-L1-SAFE-02 (final-gate aggregation portion) (spec §8)
- The fail-closed `SEND_MODE`/`CRM_WRITE_MODE` + allowlist + `APP_ENV` boot-guard behaviors (shipped day-1 in L1) are re-asserted as the security gate's final rung: non-allowlisted send/write refused with zero provider/`PUT` calls; empty allowlist refuses all; only `full` lifts it; `full` under `APP_ENV∈{test,dev}` hard-fails at boot.

> Aggregate security gate from research section 6.5: 128-bit HMAC-only token, GET/HEAD zero writes, nonce-less POST fails, Cancel interstitial required, double POST exactly one action, expired/superseded/stale tokens cannot act, breaker hard-opens on velocity, full phones absent at rest, token URLs redacted, non-allowlisted sends/writes refused with zero provider/CRM calls, and `full` under dev/test hard-fails at boot.
